notes: WHAT THE PANEL HE PASTED ACTUALLY SAYS, term by term. perdef 94 · drep 1 · DBPM 3.4 · height 6'6" · voted-band weight 1 · not tracked. Put through the formula: 0.453 x (1.00 x 1.20) = 0.5436, plus 0.238 x 0.995 = 0.2368, plus 0.309 x 1.0 = 0.309, total PD = 1.0896. That is not a good sheet, it is the HIGHEST SHEET IN THE POOL — no card of the 10,000 composites higher. He read the card correctly and the bar was lying to him.

CEILING ONE, THE CLAMP. PD = min(PD, 1.0) ran BEFORE the percentile that ranks voted defenders. A perfect sheet overshoots 1.0 by construction (full votes alone pay 0.5436 of a 1.0 scale), so 109 voted cards — 8.6% of the voted pool — were pressed flat against 1.0, and the percentile could not see a single point of difference between the best perimeter defender ever measured and the 109th.

CEILING TWO, THE PERCENTILE. Pvot was pctile, whose maximum is (n-1)/n, never 1.0. This file already contains the fix and its diagnosis: pctile_top's own docstring says "pctile leaves the top at (n-1)/n, which quietly made a 99 unreachable for rim protection". recal_53 wrote that for rimprot; perdef was never given the same correction. Same bug, same sentence, forty-odd rounds apart.

CEILING THREE, THE BAND. 0.55 + 0.44 x Pvot maps a FULL percentile to 0.99, i.e. card 98.02. So 99 was not merely hard on perdef — it did not exist. 0.45 makes the band span exactly 55 to 99, and the floor at 0.55 is untouched so the no-vote cap of 54 still hands over cleanly.

MEASURED CEILING, BEFORE AND AFTER: the highest band value any card could reach on the old formula was 0.9758, card 96.63 — so no sheet, however perfect, could read 97 or better from the voted branch, in any season of the 47. The best perdef on the board was 97 and it belonged to Tony Allen '11, who got there on a 0.85 vote share plus a tracked reading, not on the band.

FOOTPRINT: 1,050 perdef cards move and EVERY ONE MOVES UP — zero falls. A round that only removes ceilings must have that shape; a single faller would mean the implementation was wrong. Max +6, and only 18 cards move by 5 or more. The distribution is +1:522, +2:383, +3:96, +4:31, +5:12, +6:6 — a thin lift across the voted band and a real one at its top.
